artifacts._comment: Transform demonstration artifacts - translation, rotation, scale

x_translation_cube.name: X-Translation Cube
x_translation_cube.description: X-axis translation demonstration: position.x changes from left → wait → right → wait. Red cube slides along the X-axis (horizontal), showing how translation along a single axis works. Live display shows current X offset and direction.

y_translation_cube.name: Y-Translation Cube
y_translation_cube.description: Y-axis translation demonstration: position.y changes from up → wait → down → wait. Green cube rises and falls along the Y-axis (vertical), showing elevator-like motion. Live display shows current Y offset and direction.

z_translation_cube.name: Z-Translation Cube
z_translation_cube.description: Z-axis translation demonstration: position.z changes from forward → wait → back → wait. Blue cube moves along the Z-axis (depth), showing movement toward and away from the viewer. Live display shows current Z offset and direction.

axis_translation_cube.name: Axis Translation Cube
axis_translation_cube.description: Configurable axis translation demonstration. Set axis export to 0 (X), 1 (Y), or 2 (Z) to change which axis the cube translates along. Shows start → wait → end → wait pattern with trail ghosts and live labels.

translation_cube_demo.name: Translation Cube Demo
translation_cube_demo.description: Existing translation demo used in Trans_Translate_2. Interactive demonstration of 3D translation vectors.

boolean_tunnel.name: Boolean Tunnel
boolean_tunnel.description: Tunnel of hollow boolean cubes demonstrating rotation accumulation. Supports burst_mode for alternating rotating/flat sections, tunnel_rotation_x/z for orientation, and rotation_per_segment for twist amount.

parameters.burst_mode: bool - alternate rotating and flat sections
parameters.tunnel_rotation_x: float - rotate whole tunnel around X (-90 to stand up)
parameters.tunnel_rotation_z: float - rotate whole tunnel around Z
parameters.rotation_per_segment: float - degrees of rotation per cube

transformation_workbench.name: Transformation Workbench
transformation_workbench.description: Interactive VR learning tool for understanding transformations. Grabbable cube shows live 4x4 matrix updates, ghost position for comparison, and mode buttons to switch between Translate (T), Rotate (R), and Scale (S). Rotation snaps to 90° increments and shows coordinate swap notation. Matrix cells highlight based on current transformation mode.

parameters.show_matrix: bool - Show the 4x4 matrix display (default true)
parameters.show_ghost: bool - Show ghost at original position (default true)
parameters.snap_rotation_to_90: bool - Snap rotations to 90° increments (default true)

rotatescalecubes.name: Rotate Scale Cubes
rotatescalecubes.description: Demonstration of combined rotation and scaling transformations on multiple cubes.

shear_matrix_demo.name: Shear Matrix Demo
shear_matrix_demo.description: Wall panel showing shearing transformation with the visible 2x2 matrix. A unit square (blue) gets sheared into a parallelogram (orange) with fixed shear factor k=0.5. Shows [[1,k],[0,1]] matrix and transformation arrow between original and sheared shapes.
